transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just... tired, I guess. I feel worn out pretty much every day. Even if I sleep all night, when I have to get up for my cashier shift, my body and my head just feel like they're dragging. So, yeah, that's why I'm here.
Do you often feel sad or down?
No, not really. I mean... I wouldn't say sad. Just... tired.
Do you find pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?
Uh... yeah, I guess. I still like doing my regular stuff. I just... I'm mostly just tired.
Has your appetite changed recently?
Um... no. Not really. I eat about the same, I guess.
Do you have trouble concentrating?

I guess a little. Like... at work, at the register. I'll be looking right at the screen and just sort of... lose track. Just thinking about home, or... bills, I guess. And then I end up having to recount the drawer to catch a small mistake. But... yeah.
Do you feel like you're enjoying things as much as you used to?
Um... yeah, I think so. Like I was saying, it's... it's about the same. I'm just mostly tired, I guess.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think so.
Are there things that you used to find pleasurable but no longer enjoy?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... like I just said a second ago, it's pretty much the same. I still like the same stuff. Nothing's really changed like that.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?

Yeah... I guess so. It just feels like my mind is always kind of... jumping from one thing to the next. Um... just regular stuff, mostly. Like money, or... we have a relative staying with us right now. And my wife's been stressed. Plus church duties, and... I don't know, just worrying if I'm messing up at work. Just... things like that.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... probably a little over a year. Maybe... a year and three months? I guess it's been since our older relative moved in with us.
Do you find yourself moving or speaking more slowly than you used to, or feeling like you're speeding up and can't slow down?
Um... no. I don't think so. I just... move regular, I guess. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Have you lost any weight recently?
Um... no. I don't think so. I haven't really been checking or anything, but... my weight's been about the same, I guess.
Do you feel like you're withdrawn from social interactions or have trouble being around other people?
Not really. I mean... I'm around people all day at work, ringing them up, so... no, I wouldn't say that. I do fine.
Have you gained any weight recently?
Uh... no. Like I said before, it's... it's just been about the same. I haven't noticed any extra weight or anything.
Have you ever thought about hurting yourself?
No. Uh... no, never anything like that. I don't... no.
Do you feel like you're restless or fidgety, or have trouble sitting still?
Uh... no, not really. I don't think I have a problem with that. I can sit still just fine.
Do you feel like you're resting or doing things more slowly than you used to?
Uh... no, I don't think so. I just... do things about the same speed, I guess. I haven't really noticed being slower.
Do you ever feel depressed?
Uh... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think I feel depressed. Just... normal, mostly.
Do you feel like you're doing things more quickly than you used to or like you can't slow down?
No... I don't think I'm rushing or anything. I just go at my regular pace, I guess. I haven't noticed any difference.
Have you noticed any decrease in interest in activities or hobbies that you usually enjoy?
Um... no, I don't think so. I still do my usual stuff on my days off. It's... it's about the same, really.
